# redo_ensembles_claude.txt
# Blackboard / master manifest of the REDO production ensembles (corrected-gsq, bug-fixed) on AFFINE.
# All live under /lustre2/affine/redo/ ; generated by the _fermilab block driver (Hasenbusch, Nf-packed,
# split-pole D/Df, frozen Zolotarev window). See params_L1L2_claude.md / params_massive_claude.md and the
# cost doc redo_cost_estimate_claude.md. 26 streams = 18 massless (Nf{2,4,6}) + 8 massive (Nf2).
#
# NOTE (2026-07-16): the L1/L2 rows below are the AFFINE (Fermilab, SLURM) campaign. The L=4 ensembles are
# generated SEPARATELY on the BU SCC (SGE qsub) with the _scc driver -- see the "L4 (SCC)" section appended
# at the BOTTOM of this file (impl plan: scc_L4_production_impl_plan_claude.md). L4 is Nf=2-only (per NM).
#

#   ensemble   output dir3 basename

#   slot       wrapper pair-slot p<idx> (run_wrapper_redo_claude.sh); packed 2/GPU under MPS
#   L Nf gsq mRe   lattice refinement / flavors / coupling / physical mass (R=1)

#   ncfg       ckpoint_lat configs on disk NOW (snapshot)

#   acc%       acceptance over all this stream's logs ; maxdH = max |dH|  (health)
#

# gpu_c8.0). Targets: massless -> 400 traj, massive -> 60. Monitor: bash tmp_monitor_L4_scc_claude.sh .
